en.s: The Battle of Spercheios (Bulgarian: Битка при Сперхей, Greek: Μάχη του Σπερχειού) took place in 997 AD, on the shores of the Spercheios river near the city of Lamia in central Greece. It was fought between a Bulgarian army led by Tsar Samuil, which in the previous year had penetrated south into Greece, and a Byzantine army under the command of General Nikephoros Ouranos.

zh.s: 斯佩尔凯俄斯河战役发生于公元997年，地点在希腊中部拉米亚附近的斯佩尔凯俄斯河岸。交战双方是由沙穆埃尔沙皇率领的保加利亚军队，以及由尼基弗鲁斯·乌拉诺斯将军指挥的拜占庭军队。保加利亚军队前一年曾向南推进至希腊境内。

en.t: Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa
en.s: The Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa, known in Arab history as the Battle of Al-Uqab (معركة العقاب), took place on 16 July 1212 and was an important turning point in the Reconquista and in the medieval history of Spain. The Christian forces of King Alfonso VIII of Castile were joined by the armies of his rivals, Sancho VII of Navarre, Peter II of Aragon and Afonso II of Portugal, in battle against the Berber Almohad Muslim rulers of the southern half of the Iberian Peninsula. The Caliph al-Nasir (Miramamolín in the Spanish chronicles) led the Almohad army, made up of people from the whole Almohad empire.

zh.t: 拉斯纳瓦斯·德托洛萨战役
zh.s: 拉斯纳瓦斯·德托洛萨战役在阿拉伯史料中称为阿尔乌卡卜战役，发生于1212年7月16日，是收复失地运动和西班牙中世纪史上的重要转折点。卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索八世的基督教军队与其对手纳瓦拉国王桑乔七世、阿拉贡国王佩德罗二世和葡萄牙国王阿丰索二世的军队并肩作战，对抗统治伊比利亚半岛南部的柏柏尔人穆瓦希德王朝。哈里发纳赛尔（西班牙编年史称其为米拉马莫林）率领穆瓦希德军队，军中将士来自整个穆瓦希德帝国。

en.s: The siege of Kolding (Danish: Belejringen af Kolding) also known as the siege of Koldinghus, was a siege by the County of Holstein on the Danish castle of Koldinghus in 1368 during the Danish–Hanseatic War (1361–1370). The siege would end inconclusive for both sides; however, the commander of the castle, Peder Iversøn, promised to surrender if King Valdemar IV of Denmark would die, abdicate, or lose the kingdom.

en.t: King Richard II of England is crowned
en.s: Richard II (6 January 1367 – c. 14 February 1400), also known as Richard of Bordeaux, was King of England from 1377 until he was deposed in 1399. He was the son of Edward the Black Prince and Joan of Kent. The Black Prince died in 1376, leaving Richard as heir apparent to his grandfather, King Edward III. Upon the King's death, the 10-year-old Richard succeeded to the throne.

zh.t: 英格兰国王理查二世加冕
zh.s: 理查二世（1367年1月6日—约1400年2月14日），又称波尔多的理查，自1377年起担任英格兰国王，直至1399年被废黜。他是黑太子爱德华和肯特的琼之子。黑太子于1376年去世，理查因此成为祖父爱德华三世的王位继承人。国王去世后，年仅10岁的理查继位。

en.s: After the French lifted the siege of Orléans and won a decisive victory at the Battle of Patay, the English and Burgundians no longer posed a threat. Joan of Arc convinced the Dauphin Charles to go to Reims for his coronation. Successfully marching their army though the heart of territory held by the hostile Burgundians solidified the Dauphin’s regrasp of the throne of France.

en.t: Jacques Cartier, navigator and explorer, returns home to St. Malo after claiming Stadacona (Quebec), Hochelaga (Montreal) and the River of Canada (St. Lawrence River) region for France
en.s: Jacques Cartier (Breton: Jakez Karter; 31 December 1491 – 1 September 1557) was a French maritime explorer from Brittany. Jacques Cartier was the first European to describe and map the Gulf of Saint Lawrence and the shores of the Saint Lawrence River, which he named "Canada" after the Iroquoian names for the two big settlements he saw at Stadacona (Quebec City) and at Hochelaga (Montreal Island).

zh.s: 雅克·卡蒂埃（布列塔尼语：Jakez Karter；1491年12月31日—1557年9月1日）是来自布列塔尼的法国航海探险家。他是首位描述并绘制圣劳伦斯湾及圣劳伦斯河沿岸地图的欧洲人；他以“加拿大”称呼该地区，名称取自他在斯塔达科纳（魁北克市）和奥什拉加（蒙特利尔岛）见到的易洛魁人两处大型聚居地的名称。

en.s: The Battle of Cape Gelidonya or Celidonia took place on 14 July 1616 during the Ottoman–Habsburg struggle for the control of the Mediterranean. During its course, a small privateer fleet owned by Spanish Viceroy of Sicily Pedro Téllez-Girón, Duke of Osuna, under the command of Francisco de Ribera, was attacked by an Ottoman fleet that vastly outnumbered it while cruising off Cyprus.

zh.s: 瓦朗谢讷战役于1656年7月16日在法西战争期间爆发，地点在西属尼德兰的瓦朗谢讷城郊。交战双方是奥地利的约翰·约瑟夫率领的西班牙军队，以及亨利·德·拉图尔·奥弗涅子爵蒂雷纳率领的法国军队。

en.s: The Battle of Penghu (Chinese: 澎湖海戰) was a naval battle fought in 1683 between the Qing dynasty and the Kingdom of Tungning. The Qing admiral Shi Lang led a fleet to attack the Tungning forces in Penghu. Each side possessed more than 200 warships, while the Tungning admiral Liu Guoxuan's forces were outnumbered by Shi Lang's three to one.
en.n: Manchu Qing dynasty naval forces under commander Shi Lang defeat the Kingdom of Tungning in the Battle of Penghu near the Pescadores Islands.

zh.s: 澎湖海战发生于1683年，是清朝与东宁王国之间的一场海战。清朝水师提督施琅率舰队进攻澎湖的东宁军。双方都拥有200多艘战船，东宁军人数处于劣势；其将领刘国轩的兵力只有施琅的三分之一。
zh.n: 施琅率领的满清水师在澎湖群岛附近击败东宁王国。

en.s: The Battle of Emsdorf was fought on 16 July 1760 during the Seven Years' War at Emsdorf in present-day Hesse, Germany, between forces of British, Hanoverian and Hessian troops under the Prince of Hesse-Kassel (or Hesse-Cassel) against German troops in French service under Marechal de Camp von Glaubitz. It was part of the campaign to disrupt the French line of communications by capturing Marburg, a French supply depot.

zh.s: 埃姆斯多夫战役于1760年7月16日在七年战争期间爆发，战场位于今德国黑森州的埃姆斯多夫。黑森-卡塞尔亲王率领英国、汉诺威和黑森军队，对阵在法国服役、由陆军少将冯·格劳比茨指挥的德意志军队。这场战役是扰乱法军交通线行动的一部分，目标是攻占法国补给仓库马尔堡。

en.s: The Battle of Villinghausen (or Vellinghausen, also known as the Battle of Kirchdenkern), took place during the Seven Years' War fought on the 15th and 16 July 1761 in the western area of present-day Germany, between a large French army and an Anglo-German force led by Prince Ferdinand of Brunswick. The French commanders failed to coordinate their actions and suffered defeat.

zh.s: 维林豪森战役又称韦林豪森战役或基希登克恩战役，是七年战争期间的一场战斗，于1761年7月15日至16日在今德国西部发生。法军与由不伦瑞克的斐迪南亲王率领的英德联军交战。法军指挥官未能协调行动，最终战败。

en.s: Junípero Serra Ferrer (; Spanish: [xuˈnipeɾo ˈsera]; November 24, 1713 – August 28, 1784), popularly known simply as Junipero Serra, was a Spanish Catholic priest and missionary of the Franciscan Order. He is credited with establishing the Franciscan Missions in the Sierra Gorda, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

zh.t: 胡尼佩罗·塞拉神父建立加州首个传教站圣迭戈·德·阿尔卡拉传教站，数十年后发展为加利福尼亚州圣迭戈市
zh.s: 胡尼佩罗·塞拉·费雷尔（西班牙语：[xuˈnipeɾo ˈsera]；1713年11月24日—1784年8月28日），通常简称胡尼佩罗·塞拉，是西班牙方济各会天主教神父和传教士。他因在塞拉戈尔达建立方济各会传教站而闻名，该遗址现为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

en.s: The Battle of Stony Point took place on July 16, 1779, during the American Revolutionary War. In a well-planned and -executed nighttime attack, a highly trained select group of George Washington's Continental Army troops under the command of Brigadier General "Mad Anthony" Wayne defeated British troops in a quick and daring assault on their outpost in Stony Point, New York, located in present day Rockland County, approximately 30 mi (48 km) north of New York City.

zh.s: 斯托尼角战役于1779年7月16日在美国独立战争期间爆发。乔治·华盛顿大陆军中一支经过严格训练的精锐部队，由准将“疯狂安东尼”韦恩指挥，精心策划并实施了夜间突袭，迅速而大胆地击败驻守纽约州斯托尼角前哨据点的英军。斯托尼角位于今罗克兰县，距纽约市以北约30英里（48公里）。

en.t: 1789 United States Senate elections in New York
en.s: The 1789 United States Senate election in New York was held in July 1789 to elect two U.S. senators to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate. It was the first such election, and before the actual election the New York State Legislature had to establish the proceedings how to elect the senators.

zh.s: 纽约州于1789年7月举行联邦参议员选举，选出代表纽约州进入美国联邦参议院的两名联邦参议员。这是该州首次举行这类选举。在实际投票前，纽约州议会还必须制定参议员选举程序。

en.t: The District of Columbia is established as the capital of the United States after signature of the Residence Act
en.s: Washington, D.C., officially the District of Columbia and commonly known as Washington, is the federal capital city of the United States, and its only federal district. The city stands on the north-east bank of the Potomac River, across from the state of Virginia, surrounded by Maryland to its north, east, and south. The district was named for Columbia, the female personification of the American nation, through which human form and attributes are applied to the United States.

zh.t: 签署《居住法》后，哥伦比亚特区成立并成为美国首都
zh.s: 华盛顿哥伦比亚特区的正式名称为哥伦比亚特区，通常称为华盛顿，是美国联邦首都，也是美国唯一的联邦特区。该市位于波托马克河北岸，与弗吉尼亚州隔河相望，马里兰州环绕其北、东、南三面。该特区以哥伦比亚命名；哥伦比亚是美国的女性化身形象，借此将人形和属性赋予美国。

en.s: The Battle of Mendigorría Grand was a battle of the First Carlist War. It occurred on July 16, 1835 south of Mendigorría, Navarre. The Carlists were commanded by Vicente González Moreno, who assumed this post after the death of Zumalacárregui at the Siege of Bilbao. The Carlist pretender Don Carlos was also at Mendigorría. When the Liberals attacked, the Carlists found themselves in a difficult strategic position: they had the Arga River behind them and only one way across, the Bridge of Larraga. The Liberal left flank was led by Baldomero Espartero, the central flank by Luis Fernández de Córdova.

zh.s: 门迪戈里亚战役是第一次卡洛斯战争中的一场战役，发生于1835年7月16日，地点在纳瓦拉门迪戈里亚以南。卡洛斯派由比森特·冈萨雷斯·莫雷诺指挥；苏马拉卡雷吉在毕尔巴鄂围城战中去世后，他接任指挥。卡洛斯派王位觊觎者唐·卡洛斯也在门迪戈里亚。自由派发动进攻时，卡洛斯派处于不利的战略位置：他们背靠阿尔加河，只有拉拉加桥一条路可供渡河。自由派左翼由巴尔多梅罗·埃斯帕特罗指挥，中军由路易斯·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦指挥。

en.t: Antonio María Claret y Clará founds the Congregation of the Missionary Sons of the Immaculate Heart of Mary, popularly known as the Claretians in Vic, in the province of Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain
en.s: Anthony Mary Claret, (born Antoni Maria Claret i Clarà; Spanish: Antonio María Claret y Clarà; 23 December 1807 – 24 October 1870) was a Spanish Catholic prelate and missionary who served as Archbishop of Santiago de Cuba and was the confessor of Queen Isabella II. He founded the congregation of Missionary Sons of the Immaculate Heart of Mary, commonly called the Claretians.

zh.t: 安东尼奥·玛丽亚·克拉雷特在西班牙加泰罗尼亚巴塞罗那省维克创立圣母无玷之心传教会
zh.s: 安东尼·玛丽·克拉雷特（出生名安东尼·玛丽亚·克拉雷特·克拉拉；西班牙语：Antonio María Claret y Clarà，1807年12月23日—1870年10月24日）是西班牙天主教高级教士和传教士，曾任古巴圣地亚哥总主教，也是伊莎贝拉二世女王的告解神师。他创立了圣母无玷之心传教会，俗称克拉雷会。

en.t: American Civil War: At the order of President Abraham Lincoln, Union troops begin a 25-mile march into Virginia for what will become the First Battle of Bull Run, the first major land battle of the war
en.s: Abraham Lincoln (February 12, 1809 – April 15, 1865) was the 16th president of the United States, from 1861 until his assassination in 1865. He led the United States through the American Civil War, defeating the Confederacy and playing a major role in the abolition of slavery. Born in a one-room log cabin in Kentucky, Lincoln was raised on the frontier.

zh.t: 美国内战：亚伯拉罕·林肯总统下令联邦军向弗吉尼亚州推进25英里，随后爆发战争中第一场大型陆战——第一次马纳萨斯战役
zh.s: 亚伯拉罕·林肯（1809年2月12日—1865年4月15日）是美国第16任总统，1861年至1865年遇刺身亡前任职。他领导美国度过内战，击败邦联，并在废除奴隶制方面发挥重要作用。林肯出生在肯塔基州一间单室木屋，在边疆地区长大。

en.s: The Battle of Shimonoseki Straits (Japanese: 下関海戦, romanized: Shimonoseki Kaisen) was a naval engagement fought on July 16, 1863, by the United States Navy warship USS Wyoming against the powerful daimyō (feudal lord) Mōri Takachika of the Chōshū clan based in Shimonoseki. USS Wyoming, under Captain David McDougal, sailed into the strait and single-handedly engaged the US-built but poorly manned Japanese fleet.

zh.s: 下关海战发生于1863年7月16日，是美国海军军舰怀俄明号与长州藩大名毛利敬亲势力之间的一场海战。怀俄明号由戴维·麦克杜格尔舰长指挥，驶入海峡，单独迎战由美国制造但人员不足的日本舰队。

en.s: Heaton's Crossroads, also known as the Purcellville Wagon Raid, was an American Civil War skirmish that took place between Federal cavalry under Brig. Gen. Alfred N. Duffié and Confederate infantry under Maj. Gen. John C. Breckinridge on July 16, 1864, near present-day Purcellville, Virginia in Loudoun County as part of the Valley Campaigns of 1864. The action was tactically inconclusive.

zh.s: 希顿十字路口交战又称珀塞尔维尔马车突袭，是美国内战期间的一场小规模冲突，于1864年7月16日在弗吉尼亚州劳登县、今珀塞尔维尔附近发生。交战双方分别是阿尔弗雷德·N·杜菲耶准将率领的联邦骑兵，以及约翰·C·布雷肯里奇少将率领的邦联步兵。该行动是1864年谢南多厄河谷战役的一部分，战术上没有明确胜负。

en.s: The Batalle of la Loma was a minor engagement of the French intervention in Mexico which took place on 16 July 1865 in the vicinity of Hacienda de la Loma in the current municipality of Tacámbaro, Michoacán. The battle occurred members of the Mexican Republican army, led by General Porfirio Díaz, and the Belgian Legion, supporting French and Mexican Imperial troops, led by Lieutenant Colonel Alfred Van der Smissen. Besides the Belgian victory, the Mexican mission was highly expensive for Belgium because just a half of 1,500 soldiers sent to Mexico went back to Europe at the end of the war.

zh.s: 拉洛马战役是法国干涉墨西哥期间的一场小规模交战，于1865年7月16日在拉洛马庄园附近发生，该地现属米却肯州塔卡姆巴罗市镇。交战双方是波菲里奥·迪亚斯将军率领的墨西哥共和军，以及支持法国和墨西哥帝国军队、由阿尔弗雷德·范德斯米森中校率领的比利时军团。比利时虽取得胜利，但这次墨西哥远征给比利时造成沉重代价：派往墨西哥的1500名士兵中，战争结束时只有一半返回欧洲。

en.s: The Battle of Boquerón was fought on 16 July 1866 and the Battle of Sauce on 18 July 1866, between an allied force of Uruguayans, Brazilian, and Argentines on one side and Paraguay on the other in the Paraguayan War. The Spanish-born Uruguayan officer León de Pallejas (1816-1866) and the Paraguayan officer Elizardo Aquino were killed in the battle.

zh.s: 博克龙战役于1866年7月16日爆发；同一场巴拉圭战争中，萨乌塞战役于7月18日发生。交战双方一方是乌拉圭、巴西和阿根廷联军，另一方是巴拉圭军队。乌拉圭籍西班牙裔军官莱昂·德·帕列哈斯（1816—1866）和巴拉圭军官埃利萨多·阿基诺在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Nikopol, or Nicopolis (Turkish: Niğbolu Muharebesi), was one of the early battles of the Russo-Turkish War (1877–1878). As the Russian army crossed the Danube river, they approached the fortified city of Nikopol (Nicopolis). The Turkish high command sent Osman Pasha with the troops from Vidin to oppose the Russians' crossing of the Danube. Osman's intentions were to reinforce and defend Nikopol.

zh.s: 尼科波利斯战役又称尼科波尔战役（土耳其语：Niğbolu Muharebesi），是1877—1878年俄土战争初期的一场战斗。俄军渡过多瑙河，向设防城市尼科波尔推进。奥斯曼土耳其最高指挥部派奥斯曼帕夏率军从维丁出发，阻止俄军渡河。奥斯曼帕夏此行意在增援并守住尼科波尔。

en.s: The Battle of Witpoort was a battle during the Second Anglo-Boer War. Major Frederick Henry Munn commanded the detachment of the Royal Irish Fusiliers at Witpoort which was attacked on 16 July 1900, his orders being to "hold his position at all costs". The Boers called on Major Munn to surrender, but, scornfully refusing, he held out from daybreak till 2 pm, when the Canadian forces mounted a counterattack and the Boers retired. The battle became famous because of the death of Harold Lothrop Borden.

zh.s: 维特波特战役是第二次英布战争期间的一场战斗。1900年7月16日，弗雷德里克·亨利·芒少校率领皇家爱尔兰燧发枪团的一支分队驻守维特波特，并遭到袭击。他接到的命令是：不惜一切代价守住阵地。布尔人要求芒少校投降，他断然拒绝，从黎明坚守到下午2点。此时加拿大部队发起反击，布尔人撤退。这场战斗因哈罗德·洛思罗普·博登阵亡而广为人知。

en.t: John Robertson Duigan makes the first flight of the Duigan pusher biplane, the first aircraft built in Australia
en.s: The Duigan pusher biplane (often simply called the Duigan biplane) was an early aircraft which made the first powered flight by an Australian-designed and built machine when it flew in Victoria in 1910. The aircraft was constructed by John Duigan with help from his brother, Reginald, on their family farm at Mia Mia.

zh.s: 杜根式推进螺旋桨双翼机是一款早期飞机。它于1910年在维多利亚州完成首次动力飞行，成为首架由澳大利亚设计和制造的飞行器。约翰·杜根在家族农场米亚米亚建造了这架飞机，弟弟雷金纳德也提供了帮助。

en.t: At Treasure Island on the Delaware River in the United States, the First Order of the Arrow ceremony takes place and the Order of the Arrow is founded to honor American Boy Scouts who best exemplify the Scout Oath and Law
en.s: The Order of the Arrow (OA) is the honor society of Scouting America, composed of Scouts and Scouters who best exemplify the Scout Oath and Law in their daily lives as elected by their peers. It was founded as a camp fraternity by E. Urner Goodman, with the assistance of Carroll A. Edson, in 1915. Although it began without national approval, it was eventually admitted as an "Official Experiment" of Scouting America.

zh.t: 箭章会在美国特拉华河特雷热岛举行首场仪式并成立
zh.s: 箭章会是美国童子军协会的荣誉组织，由童子军和成人领袖组成，成员由同侪选出，以表彰他们在日常生活中最能践行童军誓词和法律。1915年，乌尔纳·古德曼在卡罗尔·A·埃德森协助下将其创办为营地社团。该组织起初没有全国层面的认可，后来被列为“正式试行项目”。

en.s: Johann Baptist Joseph Maximilian Reger (19 March 1873 – 11 May 1916) was a German composer, pianist, organist, conductor, and academic teacher. He worked as a concert pianist, a musical director at the Leipzig University Church, a professor at the Royal Conservatory in Leipzig, and a music director at the court of George II, Duke of Saxe-Meiningen. Reger first composed mainly Lieder, chamber music, choral music and works for piano and organ.

zh.s: 约翰·巴普蒂斯特·约瑟夫·马克西米利安·雷格（1873年3月19日—1916年5月11日）是德国作曲家、钢琴家、管风琴演奏家、指挥家和学术教师。他曾担任音乐会钢琴家、莱比锡大学教堂音乐总监、莱比锡皇家音乐学院教授，以及萨克森-迈宁根公爵乔治二世宫廷的音乐总监。雷格早期创作主要包括艺术歌曲、室内乐、合唱音乐以及钢琴和管风琴作品。

A large force of rebels loyal to Augusto César Sandino attacked the garrison of Ocotal, which was held by a small group of US Marines and Nicaraguan National Guards. en.s: The Battle of Mount Tambu was a series of actions fought in the Salamaua area of the Territory of New Guinea between Allied and Japanese forces, which took place between 16 July and 18 August 1943, during World War II. The battle formed part of the wider Salamaua–Lae campaign and was fought in the final stages of the campaign, which had seen a combined Australian and US force advance from Wau towards Salamaua following the repulse of the Japanese attack on Wau in late January and early February 1943.

en.t: The first atomic weapons test was conducted near Alamogordo, New Mexico, on July 16, 1945, during the Manhattan Project, and given the codename "Trinity"
en.s: Nuclear weapons tests are experiments carried out to determine the performance of nuclear weapons and the effects of their explosion. Over 2,000 nuclear weapons tests have been carried out since 1945. Nuclear testing is a sensitive political issue. Governments have often performed tests to signal strength. Because of their destruction and fallout, testing has seen opposition by civilians as well as governments, with international bans having been agreed on.

zh.t: 曼哈顿计划期间，首枚原子武器于1945年7月16日在新墨西哥州阿拉莫戈多附近进行试验，代号“三位一体”
zh.s: 核武器试验是为确定核武器性能及其爆炸影响而进行的实验。自1945年以来，全球已进行了2,000多次核武器试验。核试验是敏感的政治议题，各国政府常以试验展示实力。由于核武器造成的破坏和放射性沉降，民众和各国政府都曾反对核试验，国际社会也已达成禁试协议。

en.s: Miss Macao (Chinese: 澳門小姐; Sidney Lau: O3 Moon4 Siu2 Je2) was a Catalina seaplane owned by Cathay Pacific and operated by subsidiary Macau Air Transport Company. On 16 July 1948 it was involved in the first hijacking of a commercial aircraft. Piracy for robbery and ransom was the motive. The aircraft crashed after the pilot was shot while resisting the attackers; 25 people died, including three hijackers, but one hijacker survived by jumping out of the airplane before impact.

zh.s: “澳门小姐”号是一架卡塔琳娜水上飞机，由国泰航空拥有并由其子公司澳门航空运输公司运营。1948年7月16日，该机遭遇了首起商业航空客机劫持事件。劫机者的动机是抢劫和索要赎金。飞行员抵抗时遭枪击，飞机随后坠毁，机上25人死亡，其中包括3名劫机者；另有一名劫机者在飞机撞地前跳机逃生。

en.s: The death of Lau Yew took place at the beginning of the Malayan Emergency. British security forces and Malayan Police clashed with those of the Malayan Communist Party resulting in the death of one of their key leaders, Lau Yew. He had been betrayed by his own bodyguard. en.t: Uruguay v Brazil (1950 FIFA World Cup)
en.s: The match between Uruguay and Brazil was the decisive match of the final stage at the 1950 FIFA World Cup. It was played at the Maracanã Stadium in the then-capital of Brazil, Rio de Janeiro, on 16 July 1950. Uniquely to this World Cup, as all other editions have concluded with a one-off final, the winner was the team with the most points after round-robin games between the top four teams.

zh.t: 乌拉圭对巴西（1950年世界杯）
zh.s: 乌拉圭对巴西的比赛是1950年国际足联世界杯决赛阶段的决定性一战。比赛于1950年7月16日在巴西当时的首都里约热内卢马拉卡纳体育场举行。这届世界杯的赛制不同于其他届次：冠军不是通过一场决赛产生，而是由四支队伍进行循环赛，积分最高的队伍夺冠。

en.s: The Chaplain–Medic massacre took place in the Korean War on July 16, 1950, on a mountain above the village of Tuman (current Duman-ri, Geumnam-myeon, Sejong City). South Korean local natives claim that it took place on a mountain above the village of Yongdam-ri, which is next to Duman-ri. Thirty unarmed, critically wounded United States Army (US) soldiers and an unarmed chaplain were murdered by members of the Korean People's Army (KPA) during the Battle of the Kum River.

zh.s: 牧师与军医屠杀案发生于1950年7月16日的朝鲜战争期间，地点在图曼村（今世宗市锦南面杜万里）上方的山上。韩国当地居民称，屠杀地点是在邻近杜万里的龙潭里上方山上。朝鲜人民军成员在锦江战役期间杀害了30名手无寸铁、身负重伤的美国陆军士兵和一名未携武器的随军牧师。

en.s: The United States of Indonesia invaded the island of Buru, one of the three major islands in the South Moluccas region then under the control of the Republic of South Maluku, on 14 July 1950. Codenamed Operation Night (Indonesian: Operasi Malam) by the Indonesian military, it resulted in a swift occupation of the island within two days. It was one of the first organized combined-arms operations conducted by post-independence Indonesia.

en.t: J. D. Salinger publishes his popular yet controversial novel, The Catcher in the Rye
en.s: Jerome David Salinger ( SAL-in-jər; January 1, 1919 – January 27, 2010) was an American writer best known for his 1951 novel The Catcher in the Rye. Salinger published several short stories in Story magazine in 1940, before serving in World War II. In 1948, his critically acclaimed story "A Perfect Day for Bananafish" appeared in The New Yorker, which published much of his later work.

zh.t: J·D·塞林格出版畅销却颇具争议的小说《麦田里的守望者》
zh.s: 杰罗姆·戴维·塞林格（读作 SAL-in-jər；1919年1月1日—2010年1月27日）是美国作家，以1951年小说《麦田里的守望者》闻名。1940年，他曾在《Story》杂志发表多篇短篇小说，之后参加第二次世界大战。1948年，他广受评论界赞誉的小说《逮香蕉鱼的最佳日子》发表于《纽约客》，该刊后来还发表了他的许多作品。

en.t: King Leopold III of Belgium abdicates in favor of his son, Baudouin of Belgium
en.s: Leopold III (3 November 1901 – 25 September 1983) was King of the Belgians from 23 February 1934 until his abdication on 16 July 1951. At the outbreak of World War II, Leopold tried to maintain Belgian neutrality, but after the German invasion in May 1940, he surrendered his country, earning him much hostility, both at home and abroad.

zh.t: 比利时国王利奥波德三世退位，由其子博杜安继位
zh.s: 利奥波德三世于1934年2月23日至1951年7月16日担任比利时国王，并于当日退位。第二次世界大战爆发时，他试图维持比利时中立；1940年5月德国入侵后，他宣布投降，因此在国内外都受到强烈指责。

en.s: The 1952 Quebec general election was held on July 16, 1952, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Quebec, Canada. The incumbent Union Nationale, led by Maurice Duplessis, won re-election, defeating the Quebec Liberal Party, led by Georges-Émile Lapalme. This was the fourth time (and the third in a row) that Duplessis led his party to a general election victory.

zh.s: 1952年魁北克大选于1952年7月16日举行，选举加拿大魁北克省立法议会议员。由莫里斯·杜普莱西领导的执政民族联盟再次当选，击败由乔治-埃米尔·拉帕尔姆领导的魁北克自由党。这是杜普莱西第四次（也是连续第三次）带领本党赢得大选。

en.s: KLM (Royal Dutch Airlines) Flight 844 was an international scheduled passenger flight from Biak-Mokmer Airport, Dutch New Guinea (now Indonesia) to Manila International Airport, Manila, Philippines on 16 July 1957, which crashed into Cenderawasih Bay 1.2 kilometres (0.75 mi; 0.65 nmi) from its departure airport. As a result, 58 (9 of which were crew members) out of 68 onboard perished.

zh.s: 荷兰皇家航空844号班机是一趟定期国际客运航班，于1957年7月16日从荷属新几内亚（今印度尼西亚）的比亚克-莫克默机场飞往菲律宾马尼拉国际机场。飞机起飞后在距机场1.2公里（0.75英里；0.65海里）的森德拉瓦西湾坠毁。机上68人中有58人遇难，其中9人是机组成员。

en.t: The Mont Blanc Tunnel linking France and Italy opens
en.s: The Mont Blanc Tunnel (French: Tunnel du Mont-Blanc, Italian: Traforo del Monte Bianco) is a highway tunnel between France and Italy, under Mont Blanc in the Alps. It links Chamonix, Haute-Savoie, France with Courmayeur, Aosta Valley, Italy, via the French Route Nationale 205 and the Italian Traforo T1 (forming the European route E25), in particular the motorways serving Geneva (A40 of France) and Turin (A5 of Italy).

zh.t: 连接法国与意大利的勃朗峰隧道通车
zh.s: 勃朗峰隧道（法语：Tunnel du Mont-Blanc；意大利语：Traforo del Monte Bianco）是阿尔卑斯山勃朗峰下方连接法国和意大利的一条公路隧道。隧道通过法国205号国道和意大利T1隧道（构成欧洲E25公路）连接法国上萨瓦省夏蒙尼和意大利奥斯塔谷库马耶乌尔，并接通通往日内瓦的法国A40高速公路和通往都灵的意大利A5高速公路。

en.s: The Warrington by-election, 1981 was held on 16 July 1981. The by-election was caused by the appointment of Thomas Williams, Labour Party Member of Parliament (MP) for Warrington, as a High Court Judge. Warrington had been held by the Labour Party since the 1945 general election, and by Williams since the Warrington by-election, 1961. It had long been regarded as a safe seat for the party, and even in 1979, generally a year of poor results for Labour, Williams won with a majority of 32.8%. Labour expected to hold the seat comfortably, and selected Doug Hoyle, the former MP for Nelson and Colne, who had lost his seat in 1979.

zh.s: 1981年沃灵顿补选于1981年7月16日举行。补选缘于代表沃灵顿选区的工党议员托马斯·威廉姆斯获任高等法院法官。自1945年大选以来，沃灵顿一直由工党赢得；自1961年沃灵顿补选以来，威廉姆斯一直担任该选区议员。该席位长期被视为工党的稳固选区。即使在工党普遍表现不佳的1979年，威廉姆斯仍以32.8%的多数票胜出。工党原以为可以轻松保住席位，并提名曾代表尼尔森和科尔恩选区、于1979年失去议席的前议员道格·霍伊尔。

en.s: Mahathir bin Mohamad (Jawi: محاضر بن محمد; Malay: [mahade(r) muhammad, -ðe(r)] ; born 10 July 1925) is a Malaysian politician, physician and author who served as the fourth and seventh prime minister of Malaysia from 1981 to 2003 and again from 2018 to 2020. zh.t: 马哈蒂尔·穆罕默德就任马来西亚首相
zh.s: 马哈蒂尔·宾·穆罕默德（爪夷文：محاضر بن محمد；马来语：[mahade(r) muhammad, -ðe(r)]；1925年7月10日出生）是马来西亚政治人物、医生和作家，曾于1981年至2003年以及2018年至2020年两度担任马来西亚第四任和第七任首相。他是马来西亚任职时间最长的首相，累计任职24年。

zh.s: 1983年7月16日，英国航空直升机公司的一架西科斯基S-61商用直升机（注册号Oscar November，G-BEON），即5918号班机，在能见度不佳时从彭赞斯飞往锡利群岛圣玛丽岛途中，在大西洋凯尔特海南部坠毁。机上26人中仅6人生还。这是当时英国最严重的民用航空直升机事故。

en.t: Declaration of State Sovereignty of Ukraine
en.s: The Declaration of State Sovereignty of Ukraine (Ukrainian: Декларація про державний суверенітет України, romanized: Deklaratsiia pro derzhavnyi suvernitet Ukrainy, IPA: [deklɐˈrɑts⁽ʲ⁾ijɐ pro derˈʒɑu̯nɪj sʊweren⁽ʲ⁾iˈtɛt ʊkrɐˈjinɪ]) was adopted on July 16, 1990, by the recently elected parliament of Ukrainian SSR by a vote of 355 for and four against. The declaration established Ukraine, not Ukrainian SSR, as official name of the republic, and defined it as a sovereign nation state developing on the base of Ukrainian people's right for self-determination.

zh.s: 乌克兰国家主权宣言于1990年7月16日由新选出的乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国议会通过，表决结果为355票赞成、4票反对。宣言将乌克兰而非乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国确定为共和国的正式名称，并宣布乌克兰是一个主权国家，其发展建立在乌克兰人民自决权的基础上。

en.s: The 1990 Luzon earthquake occurred on July 16 at 4:26 p.m. (PHDT) on the densely populated island of Luzon in the Philippines. The shock had a surface-wave magnitude of 7.8 and produced a 125 km-long ground rupture that stretched from Dingalan to Kayapa. The event was a result of strike-slip movements along the Philippine Fault and the Digdig Fault within the Philippine fault system.

en.s: On July 16, 1999, John F. Kennedy Jr. died when the light aircraft he was piloting crashed into the Atlantic Ocean off Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts. Kennedy's wife, Carolyn Bessette Kennedy, and sister-in-law, Lauren Bessette, were also on board and died. The Piper Saratoga departed from New Jersey's Essex County Airport; its intended route was along the coastline of Connecticut and across Rhode Island Sound to Martha's Vineyard Airport.

zh.s: 1999年7月16日，小约翰·肯尼迪驾驶轻型飞机在马萨诸塞州玛莎葡萄园岛附近坠入大西洋身亡。他的妻子卡罗琳·贝塞特·肯尼迪和妻妹劳伦·贝塞特也在飞机上，二人同样遇难。这架派珀萨拉托加飞机从新泽西州埃塞克斯县机场起飞，原计划沿康涅狄格州海岸飞行，穿越罗得岛海峡，前往玛莎葡萄园机场。

zh.s: 2000年热浪摔角大赛是极限冠军摔角（ECW）主办的第七届热浪职业摔角付费观看赛事，于2000年7月16日在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的大奥林匹克礼堂举行。这也是最后一场以ECW名义举办的赛事。比赛共安排8场职业摔角对决。

en.s: The 2000 Ulster Senior Football Championship Final was the showpiece game of that year's Ulster Championship, contested by Armagh and Derry and played at St Tiernach's Park, Clones on 16 July 2000. Armagh won the game by 1–12 to 1–11, qualifying for the All-Ireland Semi Final against Munster Champions Kerry.

zh.s: 2000年阿尔斯特高级足球锦标赛决赛是当年阿尔斯特锦标赛的重头戏，由阿马郡队对阵德里郡队，于2000年7月16日在克隆斯的蒂尔纳赫公园举行。阿马郡队是卫冕冠军，上一年也在决赛阶段击败了唐郡队。阿马郡队以1球12分比1球11分获胜，晋级全爱尔兰半决赛，对阵芒斯特冠军克里郡队。

en.s: Operation Khukri was a multinational operation launched in the United Nations Mission in Sierra Leone (UNAMSIL), involving India, Ghana, Britain and Nigeria. The aim of the operation was to break the two-month-long siege laid by armed cadres of the Revolutionary United Front (RUF) around two companies of 5/8th Gorkha Rifles Infantry Battalion Group of the Indian Army at Kailahun by effecting a fighting breakout and redeploying them with the main battalion at Daru.

en.t: End of the tenure of Antony Leung
en.s: Antony Leung Kam-chung GBS OBE JP (born 29 January 1952) is a businessman who served as Financial Secretary of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR), from 29 May 2001 until his resignation on 16 July 2003. He was embroiled in a financial scandal in early 2003 after it was revealed he had bought an expensive Lexus car shortly before imposing a new car tax, creating a controversy over conflict of interest that earned him the nickname "Lexus Leung" and which ultimately led to his resignation in July of that year.

zh.s: 梁锦松（GBS、OBE、JP）是一名商人，曾于2001年5月29日至2003年7月16日担任香港特别行政区财政司司长。2003年初，外界发现他在新车税出台前不久购买了一辆昂贵的雷克萨斯汽车，引发利益冲突争议。他因此获得“雷克萨斯松”的绰号，最终于当年7月辞职。

en.s: The Leyenda de Plata (2004) was professional wrestling tournament produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council") that ran from July 16, 2004, over the course of three of CMLL's Friday night shows in Arena México with the finals on July 30, 2004. The annual Leyenda de Plata tournament is held in honor of lucha libre legend El Santo and is one of CMLL's most important annual tournaments.

zh.s: 2004年白银传奇锦标赛是由墨西哥职业摔角推广组织墨西哥世界摔角理事会主办的职业摔角赛事，比赛从2004年7月16日开始，分三个周五晚场次在墨西哥竞技场举行，决赛于7月30日进行。白银传奇是为纪念摔角传奇人物圣多而举办的年度赛事，也是墨西哥世界摔角理事会最重要的年度锦标赛之一。

en.s: Millennium Park is a public park in the Loop community area of Chicago, Illinois, United States, operated by the Chicago Department of Cultural Affairs and Special Events (DCASE). en.s: The Kuomintang chairmanship election of 2005 (Chinese: 2005年中國國民黨主席選舉) was held on July 16, 2005 in Taiwan between Ma Ying-jeou and Wang Jin-pyng. The election was triggered by the retirement of chairman Lien Chan. This was the second direct election of the chairman in Kuomintang history. All registered, due-paying KMT party members were eligible to vote. Previous leaders of the KMT had been elected by the party congress in a one-man race (with the candidate being either the incumbent or his designated successor). Lien ran unopposed in 2001, but his election was decided by rank and file party members.

zh.s: 2005年中国国民党主席选举于2005年7月16日在台湾举行，候选人为马英九和王金平。选举因主席连战退休而举行。这是国民党历史上第二次直接选举党主席，所有完成登记并缴纳党费的党员都有投票资格。此前，国民党领导人由党代表大会选出，通常只有一名候选人，可能是现任主席或其指定接班人。连战在2001年曾经无竞争对手，但当时仍由普通党员投票决定当选。

en.s: The 2006 Dutch-Australian offensive was a military operation carried out in Afghanistan by a combined force of Dutch and Australian troops that commenced in late April 2006 and concluded on 16 July 2006. The force entered the Taliban-controlled Chora District and Balochistan region, both of which are located north-east of the provincial capital, Tarin Kowt. The offensive's goal was to protect Tarin Kowt, the site of a soon-to-be base, from a potential Taliban attack.

en.s: The 2006 Ukrainian Super Cup became the third edition of Ukrainian Super Cup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Ukrainian Top League and Ukrainian Cup competitions. en.s: Operation Marne Avalanche was a US military operation that occurred in southern Baghdad in July 2007 as part of Operation Phantom Thunder. en.s: The Battle of Vidattaltivu was fought over the town of Vidattaltivu, Sri Lanka, by the 58 Division of the Sri Lankan Military and the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE). en.t: Teoh Beng Hock, an aide to a politician in Malaysia is found dead on the rooftop of a building adjacent to the offices of the Anti-Corruption Commission, sparking an inquest that gains nationwide attention
en.s: Teoh Beng Hock (20 April 1979 – 16 July 2009) was a Chinese Malaysian journalist and political aide to Ean Yong Hian Wah, a member of the Selangor state legislative assembly and state executive council. On 15 July 2009, the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) took Teoh was initially scheduled to meet investigators regarding allegations of corruption, but before the session could take place, he was reported missing.

en.s: On July 16, 2015, Muhammad Youssef Abdulazeez opened fire on two military installations in Chattanooga, Tennessee, United States. He first committed a drive-by shooting at a recruiting center, then traveled to a U.S. Navy Reserve center and continued firing, where he was killed by police in a gunfight. Four Marines died on the spot. A Navy sailor, a Marine recruiter, and a police officer were wounded; the sailor died from his injuries two days later.
